code: A harmless out-of-bounds read occurs during UCS table building.
note: The candidate targets the table-building path implicated by the description, where attacker-controlled compressed input can drive Huffman/UCS table construction.
Dynamic Huffman code lengths parsed from the compressed stream are passed into inflate_table() for literal/length table construction.
The routine assumes lens[] entries are in range 0..MAXBITS and uses them to index count[], so malformed lengths can perturb table construction state.
The sorted symbol list drives table entry generation; the code branches on symbol values while building decode entries from attacker-influenced lengths.

When the code set is incomplete, the function writes an invalid marker into the decode table; the vulnerability hypothesis is that this table-building path can also read past the intended UCS/table bounds during malformed input handling.
